stock.description: Tu Yi Holding Company Limited, an investment holding firm, specializes in providing comprehensive outbound travel services and package tours across Mainland China, Taiwan, and Japan. Its offerings encompass the creation, development, and sales of package tours for international travel, day excursions, and tailored products for independent travelers. Furthermore, Tu Yi provides essential services such as visa application assistance and various other supporting travel-related products. The firm also manages air ticket bookings, acts as an agent for travel and hotel accommodations, and operates its own hotel. Established in 2008, Tu Yi is headquartered in Hangzhou, People's Republic of China.
